name: pybind11
$comment: vcpkg's own pybind11, but with its python3 on Windows only: on Linux that python3's libpython3.12.so.1.0 sits in vcpkg_installed/<triplet>/lib, ahead of the system one on the binaries' RUNPATH, so the app embedded vcpkg's Python instead of OpenUSD's (docs/LINUX_WSL.md). usdcc only uses pybind11::headers.
description: pybind11 is a lightweight header-only library that exposes C++ types in Python and vice versa, mainly to create Python bindings of existing C++ code
